title: Thinking of vibecoding an ai car racing game for the fun of it. Thoughts ?
author: Sorry-Version6112
selftext: For context , I am a computer science engineer along with an MBA degree. Doing this as a side project for the fun of it.

comments.author: AlgaeNo3373
comments.body:
lol why instantly downvoted I don't get this sub sometimes man. 

Do it OP. 

I am making a car-type thing and it's already pretty fun to zoom about after just a few weeks of iterating. It feels like a very forgiving way to learn and experiment, with a familiar genre that can go many ways, even when it's narrowed further to a racing thing. 

Just do eet.

replies.author: Sorry-Version6112
replies.body: Thanks! I will keep posting here as I make progress

comments.author: Limp_Bus3865
comments.body: what is the point of this announcement?

replies.author: Sorry-Version6112
replies.body: Basically to see the response of the community. I am new here.

comments.author: redditscraperbot2
comments.body: You don’t need anyone’s permissions or inputs to do the things you want to do.

replies.author: Sorry-Version6112
replies.body: Well,, others' input and experience can help make mine better :)

replies.author: LocoMod
replies.body:
Don’t do it. The fact that you had to ask the most basic question to decide if you should do this instead of doing it out of your own motivation and passion means you’ll not only be wasting your time, but ours when you come back and ask things like “is the wheel round enough?”.

Just leave this sub and never come back. Just go continue doing computer science stuff and go get that PhD next. There is nothing for you here.

comments.author: JDad67
comments.body:
Do it. It’s good experience if nothing else. I do a new game, just for fun, every few weeks.

Opus 5.5. Have Blender installed. Think about using Godot.

comments.author: reality_comes
comments.body: When the cost to implement an idea is 0, the success or failure of the idea is meaningless. There is nothing to discuss, but it will be fun.
